items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 12 at 1:59PM EST until November 13 at 7:00PM EST by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 4 to 5 ft expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Parramore Island to Cape Charles
Light VA out 20 NM and Coastal Waters from Cape Charles Light
to Virginia-North Carolina border out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 7 PM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
